contributions.detail: Two rows, 37.50 + 105.44 = EXACTLY 142.94 = the printed TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS at the foot of Form A = the cover line-1 'Total THIS Report' cell. It is NOT the cumulative 1,210.38; the cover's own addition closes independently (1,067.44 LAST + 142.94 THIS = 1,210.38 CUMULATIVE, exact), which confirms the ledger is PER-PERIOD on this filing - a DIFFERENT scope from the cumulative figure the module publishes, so reconciles_* left blank for it is correct, not a failure. This 2025/26 cover generation prints only THREE money lines - there is no 'aggregate of $50.00 or less' line at all - so cover_le50_* are null (field absent) and the sub-$50 trap cannot arise.

gates.balance_chain: The cover's balance line prints a bare dash in all three columns, so it is transcribed BLANK (a dash is not a numeral). Arithmetically it is consistent with zero: contributions cumulative 1,210.38 minus expenses cumulative 1,210.38 = 0. The cross-report chain is also visible WITHIN this cover and closes: 1,067.44 (from last report) + 142.94 (this report) = 1,210.38 (cumulative), on BOTH the contribution and the expense line. The earlier filing that produced the 1,067.44 is not in this chunk.

notes: Generation-2 county-branded form, 2025/26 revision. Cover 'Candidate for Office Of' reads 'County Attorney'; the chunk file says 'Attorney' - the same office, stated more fully on the form.
